acceptanceCriteria: the CRB-V0-017 exported-current proof uses the single in-tree checkout root and no code or doc reads CORVINT_PROOF_TASKS_ROOT
body: Filed 2026-09-25 from PR #233 follow-ups. After corvint-tasks moved in-tree (decision 0397), internal/companionrelease/exported_current_test.go still reads the retired CORVINT_PROOF_TASKS_ROOT separate-checkout root, so the CRB-V0-017 proof depends on an external checkout that no longer exists.

completion.reason: Stale: every acceptance criterion is already met on origin/main (verified at a5aeee41). Evidence: docs/build-log/2026-10-06-stale-ticket-closure.md at 5a7045a537610b0afe2117428c8268c5d938c074 (PR beamfall/corvint#629), row V1-0347: commit a3df78aa; AC1: exported_current_test.go derives Tasks from the single Core export; CORVINT_PROOF_TASKS_ROOT remains only in historical documentation, with no executable consumer. Read-only independent verification (Codex batch C) plus mechanical check of cited commits, tests and paths; no suite rerun for this closure.

title: CRB-V0-017 exported-current proof still reads CORVINT_PROOF_TASKS_ROOT after the in-tree move
